name: claude-pulse
description: Real-time status bar indicator for the exact % of your Claude Code rate-limit window used (real data from Anthropic, not an estimate).

claudePulse.preciseMode.description: Fetches the real 5h/7d window % directly from Anthropic (running `claude -p` in the background periodically). Recommended — without this, the % is just an imprecise local estimate. Turn it off if you don't want the extension to run `claude` periodically.

claudePulse.preciseProbeIntervalSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to query Anthropic for the exact % (only if preciseMode is on). Each query is a minimal real request (~$0.0002) via `claude -p --no-session-persistence` — kept at 30s minimum to avoid abuse.

claudePulse.claudeBinaryPath.description: Path to the `claude` binary if it's not on VS Code's PATH (empty = use `claude` from PATH).

claudePulse.tokenLimit5h.description: Only used as a fallback if preciseMode is off or the probe fails: estimated output tokens for 100% of the 5h window. Anthropic doesn't publish the exact number.

claudePulse.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) local session files are re-read (24h-7d cost/tokens). Doesn't affect the exact %, which uses its own interval (preciseProbeIntervalSeconds).

claudePulse.displayMode.description: What to show in the status bar next to the visual bar.

claudePulse.projectsDir.description: Path to ~/.claude/projects if it's not in the default location (empty = autodetect).
